rows.grounds: compound of rākinī, kinnarī, and saṃgha; nominative plural masculine with sandhi before the next word
compound of bhūtinī, ceṭaka, and ādi; nominative plural masculine

items.question: Which further beings and attendant groups complete the list of hostile or liminal entities?
premises: rākinī and kinnarī groups are named
items.inference: The verse adds rākinī-kinnarī groups and bhūtinī-attendant classes to the enumerated beings.
uncertainties: the exact sandhi treatment of saṃghā before bhūtinī
the precise scope of ādayaḥ in this list
items.plain_english: Groups of rākinīs and kinnarīs, bhūtinīs, attendants, and the rest.
